name: mac-alt-hub
description: A macOS-style hub for verified direct-download alternatives to paid Mac utility apps.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @macalthub/catalog && npm run build -w @macalthub/chatgpt && npm run build -w @macalthub/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @macalthub/catalog && npm run typecheck -w @macalthub/chatgpt && npm run typecheck -w @macalthub/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @macalthub/catalog && npm run test -w @macalthub/chatgpt
scripts.release:prepare: node scripts/prepare-release.mjs && npm run sync:macos && npm run version:check
